title: Ember the Baby Dragon
description: A chunky friendly baby dragon sitting up with bat wings, back spikes, horns and a curled tail. Original character design.
use: Display figure, tabletop RPG mini scale-up, gift.
material: PLA, any colour (a gradient/silk filament looks great). Print as-is, 0.16-0.2 mm layers, 15% infill; horns/wing tips are thin - print slowly.
